repo_prior_art.cite: panel_closegroup_weaksep_honest_frontier concerns exact donor-score faces, not a generated-center replicated-site minimax experiment.

published_prior_art.cite: AkhavanGogolashviliTsybakov2024 gives split-sample local-polynomial evaluation at a strongly-convex estimated minimizer, not the four-channel causal frontier with an external donor-location modulus.

repo_prior_art.cite: panel_mnar_eventtime_uniform_band concerns MNAR event-time bands, not replicated-site spatial-resolution and generated-center minimax phases.

published_prior_art.cite: Stone1982 supplies ordinary nonparametric-regression rates; it does not supply the replicated-site spacing plus external donor-location phase diagram.

repo_prior_art.cite: panel_closegroup_weaksep_honest_frontier is a finite-dimensional donor-face Gaussian coverage problem, not a nonparametric generated-location expected-length frontier.

published_prior_art.cite: ArmstrongKolesar2020 and CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 provide distinct ordinary-regression and synthetic-control interval constructions, not a combined four-channel expected-length equivalence.
Donoho1994 and ArmstrongKolesar2018 treat fixed Gaussian convex-class modulus problems, not the stated product experiment with realized geometry and estimated donor covariance.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: lem:causal-identification and Theorems 1–3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Event-date transport, E[B_si(0)|z_0]=m_s(z_0s), is an untestable cross-date counterfactual premise rather than a consequence of the observed panel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All causal identification, frontier, and interval claims are conditional on event-date transport; rolling pseudo-events can only diagnose pre-event stability.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3; ass:attainable-local-modulus
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The lower covariance-standardized modulus supplying the N^(-kappa) converse is maintained rather than derived from Holder smoothness or the remaining panel primitives.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The four-channel MSE and expected-length equivalences are conditional on ass:attainable-local-modulus; because this focal rate channel is assumed, the proposal is capped at field tier.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 7 gives uniform squared pointwise risk for a regularized local-polynomial estimator; Algorithm 2 sample-splits, evaluates it at an estimated minimizer, and Theorem 8 bounds estimation of the strongly-convex minimum value.

source_verification_receipts.version: Author-hosted JASA article PDF corresponding to JASA 116(536), 2021
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article constructs conditional synthetic-control prediction intervals, separates pre-treatment weight uncertainty from post-treatment prediction error, and supplies a beta-mixing blocking extension in Appendix A.

source_verification_receipts.version: Author-hosted article PDF corresponding to Annals of Statistics 36(2), 2008
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The errors-in-variables regression model observes W_jk=X_j+U_jk for replicated noisy covariates and establishes first-order equivalence to a known-error deconvolution estimator under its stated conditions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Public 2012 preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 40(2), 1132–1170
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies nonparametrically generated covariates entering regression estimation and derives a stochastic expansion for the effect of the generation step.
The paper develops simple honest nonparametric regression confidence intervals using explicit worst-case bias and studies their coverage and length properties.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a scalar theorem or corollary comparing exact-center, generated-center, and noisy-training-coordinate experiments on the same replicated-site submodel, identifying exactly when the donor-modulus term replaces deconvolution.

Make the conditional realized-geometry condition more operational by deriving a high-probability bound for the selected dyadic bandwidth from the density condition and reporting a finite-sample fallback-probability corollary.
Develop the deferred product-experiment ordered-modulus program first on a two-channel Gaussian subexperiment, with an explicit least-favorable pair and constant comparison at a phase intersection.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the two accepted conditional-scope caveats fixed; prioritize the same-class four-channel lower-bound construction and fallback-event control.
